question: How does a yogin maintain conscious control when entering another body?
premises: Entering another body requires sustained mental effort.
The yogin establishes an I-sense in the other body.
This process depends on the continued movement of intellect.
inference: Therefore, the yogin maintains mental effort and identification in the other body as long as intellect continues to operate there.
plain_english: For the yogin maintains mental effort, establishing an I-sense in another body, as long as the movement of intellect continues there.
